value: no male changed position or stopped calling during playback of E. johnstonei calls, B. bischoffi calls or white noise (17 males recorded)
eye: ear; whole-animal behavioural response of calling males (position and calling continuity)
method: field playback, A-B-A protocol, scoring of position change and call interruption in focal males
conditions: Wild calling males at the edges of artificial ponds in the visitor area of Parque Estadual das Fontes do Ipiranga (PEFI), Sao Paulo, Brazil; year of the playbacks not printed (playback calls recorded in 2020). 17 Physalaemus cuvieri males recorded; one call record discarded for external interference (so 16 call records analysed, implied, not printed). Each male heard one of six stimulus-order versions (assigned in rotation) in an A-B-A protocol (3 min silence, 9 min of stimuli at 3 min each, 3 min silence): advertisement calls of the exotic Eleutherodactylus johnstonei (dominant frequency 3.42 +/- 0.13 kHz), advertisement calls of the native Boana bischoffi (dominant frequency 1.72 +/- 0.05 kHz; heterospecific control) and white noise (bandwidth not stated). Stimulus level: 'standardized ... at 75 dB for all stimuli at approximately 1 m from the source'; speaker and directional microphone about 1 m from the focal male, so the stated measurement point is about the male's position; dB reference and weighting not stated. Number of males per stimulus-order version not reported. The null here is for position change and call interruption only. In the same males other call parameters did change: note duration rose over the experiment (F = 2.7, p < 0.05; mean 0.27 s in pre-stimulus silence to 0.30 s in post-stimulus silence), maximum frequency rose during B. bischoffi calls (printed F = 0.6, p < 0.05, an F/p pair that looks inconsistent) and minimum frequency changed during the stimuli (F = 3.02, p < 0.05; 416 Hz pre to 405 Hz post); note interval and dominant frequency did not change (p > 0.05). The abstract states E. johnstonei calls did not affect spectral or temporal call parameters while B. bischoffi calls and white noise did.
